record.context_brief: Weakly compact subsets of c_0 as vector-measure ranges
record.original_question: Let K be a weakly compact subset of c_0. Must there exist a c_0-valued countably additive vector measure whose range contains K?

evidence.quote: Problem 4.2 (Anantharaman-Diestel, [4]). Let K be a weakly compact subset of c_0. Is K contained in the range of a c_0-valued vector measure?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $c_0$ denote the Banach space of real sequences converging to $0$, equipped with the supremum norm. A function $\mu : \Sigma \to c_0$ defined on a $\sigma$-algebra $\Sigma$ of subsets of some set $\Omega$ is called a countably additive vector measure if $\mu\left(\bigcup_{n=1}^{\infty} E_n\right) = \sum_{n=1}^{\infty} \mu(E_n)$ in the norm topology of $c_0$ for every sequence $(E_n)_{n\ge 1}$ of pairwise disjoint members of $\Sigma$. The range of $\mu$ is the set $\{\mu(E) : E \in \Sigma\} \subseteq c_0$.

Suppose $K \subseteq c_0$ is weakly compact (i.e., compact in the weak topology of $c_0$). Must there exist a measurable space $(\Omega,\Sigma)$ and a countably additive vector measure $\mu : \Sigma \to c_0$ such that $K$ is contained in the range of $\mu$?
artifact.status_search_result: The question is a long-standing problem attributed to Anantharaman and Diestel concerning whether every weakly compact subset of $c_0$ lies in the range of a $c_0$-valued countably additive vector measure. Web searches turn up surveys of open problems in Banach spaces and vector-measure theory that still list related questions, and no resolution (positive or negative) was located. The status appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Compactness and Weak Compactness in Spaces of Compact-Range Vector Measures
status_evidence.snippet: Studies compactness and weak compactness in spaces of vector measures with relatively compact range in Banach spaces.
status_evidence.claim: Related literature on ranges of vector measures continues to investigate which weakly compact sets arise as subsets of vector measure ranges, with no recorded resolution of the c_0 case.

status_evidence.title: Vector Measures (Diestel–Uhl)
status_evidence.snippet: Foundational reference on vector measures, ranges of vector measures and weak compactness.
status_evidence.claim: The general framework of the problem (ranges of c_0-valued vector measures) is treated in standard references, where this Anantharaman–Diestel question remains listed as a problem.
